en.title: Run classic gameplay APIs on the browser and Android player
en.body: Compare direct game references with the original SDK declarations. Share resource reads and frame events within a game, preserve classic layout and formatted text, and use the same HTTP, socket and channel callbacks on desktop and Android.

zh.title: 在浏览器和 Android 播放器运行旧版游戏接口
zh.body: 将业务直接调用与原 SDK 声明对照。游戏内共享资源读取与逐帧事件，保留旧版布局和富文本，并在桌面和 Android 使用相同的 HTTP、套接字及渠道回调。
